fn XorInt(x: Int, y: Int) -> Int
  requires (x >= 0)
  requires (y >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if ((x == 0) and (y == 0)) then 0 else if (x == 0) then y else if (y == 0) then x else ((if ((x % 2) != (y % 2)) then 1 else 0) + (2 * XorInt((x / 2), (y / 2))))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (XorInt(0, 0) == 0)
  example (XorInt(0, 1) == 1)
{
  if ((x == 0) and (y == 0)) then 0 else if (x == 0) then y else if (y == 0) then x else ((if ((x % 2) != (y % 2)) then 1 else 0) + (2 * XorInt((x / 2), (y / 2))))
}

fn XorRange(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (0 <= a)
  requires (a <= b)
  ensures (result == (if (a == b) then a else XorInt(a, XorRange((a + 1), b))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (XorRange(0, 0) == 0)
  example (XorRange(0, 1) == 1)
{
  if (a == b) then a else XorInt(a, XorRange((a + 1), b))
}

fn solve(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (0 <= a)
  requires (a <= b)
  ensures (result == XorRange(a, b))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
